numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 188.0 million EUR; 2.4% increase; 27.6 million EUR; 25.7 million EUR
numerical_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s unaudited revenue for the period increased by 2.4% and amounted to EUR 188.0 million (EUR 183.5 million in October-December 2024). Unaudited EBITDA was EUR 27.6 million (EUR 25.7 million in October-December 2024).

numerical_claims.claim: The Group returned to net profitability in Q4 with EUR 12.2 million, reversing a net loss of EUR 5.2 million in Q4 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Unaudited net profit was EUR 12.2 million (net loss of EUR 5.2 million in October-December 2024).

numerical_claims.claim: The Management Board proposed a dividend of EUR 0.06 per share for 2025, totaling EUR 44.6 million, which was paid out in two installments during the year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: The Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on 20 May 2025 adopted a resolution to pay a dividend of EUR 0.06 per share in 2025 in the total amount of EUR 44.6 million... The first instalment of EUR 0.03 per share... was paid out on 2 July 2025. The second instalment... was paid out on 25 November 2025.
